title: Movement, Navigation, Rooms, Doors, Keys & Traversal Primitives
objective: Define reusable original MAL movement, navigation, room, connector, door, key-reference and traversal primitives over frozen MAL-01/02 semantics without creating canonical World/Scene, Inventory or Travel truth and without entering MAL-04 conflict/hazard/pickup/objective scope.

rules: MAL-03 consumes frozen MAL-02 semantic input intents and deterministic logical ticks; raw device bindings, wall-clock timing, frame timing and network latency never become traversal truth.

Rooms, positions, connectors and thresholds are MAL-local authored interaction projections bound to canonical World/Scene reference IDs when available; they do not create or replace canonical maps, scene topology, coordinates or Travel state.

A navigation graph is an ordered local projection of authored nodes and permitted edges. Reordered source/reference arrays normalize deterministically, while authored traversal order remains explicit data.
Doors and thresholds may observe authorized canonical state references. Unknown, hidden or unauthorized state remains unresolved and may not default to open, passable, unlocked or discovered.
Key checks use authorized canonical key/item reference IDs only. MAL-03 never creates, grants, duplicates, consumes, equips, transfers or deletes Inventory ownership.

Traversal success or blockage changes MAL-local session position/progress only. Crossing a transition may emit a deterministic transition-ready result reference but does not move a Character, advance Travel, mutate a Scene, commit an Event or alter Project/progression truth.
Pause/retry and accessibility-equivalent control behavior remain governed by frozen MAL-02 semantics.
AI may propose traversal definitions but cannot invent hidden topology, hidden key possession, canonical passability, destination truth or owner-domain outcomes.
forbidden: copied proprietary game/ROM movement logic, maps or level layouts
canonical World/Scene map or topology mutation
Inventory item creation, possession change or key consumption
Travel state mutation or destination commit

invalidation_events: required validation reports a materially new failure signature

validation_requirement: Exactly one MAL-03 current-family profile, zero historical predecessor fanout, genuine matching self-hosted Linux/Windows acceptance RED before production mutation, then exact-head Linux/Windows GREEN and deterministic comparison.
